istioIngress.description:
Istio ingress configuration
Use Istio Gateway and VirtualService instead of Ingress

virtualService.description:
Istio VirtualService configuration
The VirtualService defines how traffic is routed after it enters the Gateway

VolumePermissions.description:
Required to be enabled pre pgAdmin4 4.16 release, to set the ACL on /var/lib/pgadmin
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/

commonLabels.description: Add labels to all the deployed resources

dnsConfig.description:
Update pod DNS Config
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-dns-config
nameservers:
- 192.0.2.1
searches:
- ns1.svc.cluster-domain.example
- my.dns.search.suffix
options:
- name: ndots
value: "2"
- name: edns0

env.description:
pgAdmin4 startup configuration
Values in here get injected as environment variables
Chart reinstall needed to apply changes

envVarsExtra.description:
Additional environment variables
- name: POSTGRES_USERNAME
valueFrom:
secretKeyRef:
name: pgadmin.pgadmin-db.credentials.postgresql.acid.zalan.do
key: username
- name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
valueFrom:
secretKeyRef:
name: pgadmin.pgadmin-db.credentials.postgresql.acid.zalan.do
key: password

envVarsFromConfigMaps.description:
Additional environment variables from ConfigMaps
- array-of
- config-map-names

envVarsFromSecrets.description:
Additional environment variables from Secrets
- array-of
- secret-names

existingSecret.description:
Name of existing secret to use for default pgadmin credentials
env.password will be ignored and picked up from this secret

extraConfigmapMounts.description:
Additional config maps to be mounted inside a container
Can be used to map config maps for sidecar as well
- name: certs-configmap
mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs
subPath: ""
configMap: certs-configmap
readOnly: true

extraContainers.description:
Specify additional containers in extraContainers
For example, to add an authentication proxy to a pgadmin4 pod
- name: proxy
image: quay.io/gambol99/keycloak-proxy:latest
args:
- -provider=github
- -client-id=
- -client-secret=
- -github-org=<ORG_NAME>
- -email-domain=*
- -cookie-secret=
- -http-address=http://0.0.0.0:4181
- -upstream-url=http://127.0.0.1:3000
ports:
- name: proxy-web
containerPort: 4181

extraDeploy.description: List of extra manifests to deploy

extraInitContainers.description:
Additional InitContainers to initialize the pod
- name: add-folder-for-pgpass
image: "dpage/pgadmin4:latest"
command: ["/bin/mkdir", "-p", "/var/lib/pgadmin/storage/pgadmin"]
volumeMounts:
- name: pgadmin-data
mountPath: /var/lib/pgadmin
securityContext:
runAsUser: 5050

extraSecretMounts.description:
Additional secret mounts to be mounted inside a container
- name: pgpassfile
secret: pgpassfile
subPath: pgpassfile
mountPath: "/var/lib/pgadmin/storage/pgadmin/file.pgpass"
readOnly: true

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volumes to be mounted inside a container

extraVolumes.description: Additional volumes to be added to the deployment

imagePullSecrets.description:
Optionally specify an array of imagePullSecrets
Secrets must be manually created in the namespace
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/pull-image-private-registry/
- RegistryKeySecret

istioIngress.description:
Istio ingress configuration
Use Istio Gateway and VirtualService instead of Ingress

endpoints.description: A list of hostnames this Gateway will manage

gateway.description: Defines the ports on the Istio Ingress Gateway

isTlsRedirect.description: If true, the template generates a rule to redirect HTTP->HTTPS

isTlsTermination.description: If true, the gateway terminates TLS (handles HTTPS)

tlsMode.description: SIMPLE: Standard TLS, MUTUAL: mTLS, PASSTHROUGH: Send TLS to pod

selector.description:
The label selector for your existing Istio Ingress Gateway pods
This tells the Gateway resource which gateway deployment to attach to
Example: "ingressgateway" is a common default label

secretCertName.description:
The name of the K8s Secret containing the cert
Istio's Gateway resource will reference this name in its credentialName field
Should be in istio-ingress namespace where istio ingress gateway is installed

virtualService.description:
Istio VirtualService configuration
The VirtualService defines how traffic is routed after it enters the Gateway

livenessProbe.description:
pgAdmin4 health check probe configuration
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

namespace.description:
The name of the Namespace to deploy
If not set, .Release.Namespace is used

nodeSelector.description:
Node labels for pgAdmin4 pod assignment
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/node-selection/

podLabels.description:
Pod labels
key1: value1
key2: value2

preferences.description:
Pre-load pgAdmin4 with user preferences
This mounts a preferences.json file to override default UI settings such as themes,
display options, or query tool behavior
Ref: https://www.pgadmin.org/docs/pgadmin4/latest/preferences.html

priorityClassName.description: Priority class name for pod scheduling

resources.description:
Resource limits and requests
We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'
You might also want to increase failure threshold value in startup probe configuration to
allow the container to start successfully on CPU limited environments
limits:
cpu: 100m
memory: 128Mi
requests:
cpu: 100m
memory: 128Mi

revisionHistoryLimit.description: The number of old history to retain to allow rollback

secretKeys.description:
Name of key in existing secret to use for default pgadmin credentials
Only used when existingSecret is set

securityContext.description: Security context to be added to pgAdmin4 pods

serverDefinitions.description:
Pre-load pgAdmin4 with servers at first start-up
Servers are imported only the first time the config DB is created
Ref: https://www.pgadmin.org/docs/pgadmin4/latest/import_export_servers.html

strategy.description:
Strategy used to replace old Pods by new ones
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/#strategy
type: RollingUpdate
rollingUpdate:
maxSurge: 0
maxUnavailable: 1

templatedPodAnnotations.description:
Templated pod annotations
checksum/configmap-oauth2: {{ include "<parent-chart-name>/templates/configmap-oauth2.yaml" $ | sha256sum }}
checksum/secret-oauth2: "{{ include "<parent-chart-name>/templates/secret-oauth2.yaml" $ | sha256sum }}"
checksum/secret-pgpass: "{{ include "<parent-chart-name>/templates/secret-pgpass.yaml" $ | sha256sum }}"

tolerations.description:
Node tolerations for server scheduling to nodes with taints
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/

topologySpreadConstraints.description:
Topology Spread Constraints to control how Pods are spread across your cluster
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/

workload.description:
Workload type - Deployment or StatefulSet
StatefulSet is useful for stable storage and network identity
When using StatefulSet, PVCs are managed via volumeClaimTemplates
